_about: WHIP's servos. Edit this (or SERVO TYPE in Servo Studio), then reflash: flash_gaits writes scripts/esp32_gaits/servo_config.h from it first (scripts/servo_config.py). us_per_deg: pulse per degree; us_center: the pulse at 0 degrees (the middle); us_min / us_max: never past these; deg_max: the most it turns either way from the middle. Only MG995 is measured (it's what WHIP walks on); the others are their datasheet numbers: check yours on /calib before trusting them.

MG995.note: WHIP's own (the reference's Maestro range: 576-2464 us for 180 degrees)

MG996R.note: MG995's metal-gear successor, the same pulses

SG90.note: the little 9 g one: datasheet 500-2400 us for 180 degrees

DS3218 180.note: 20 kg digital, the 180 degree version: 500-2500 us

DS3218 270.note: 20 kg digital, the 270 degree version: 500-2500 us
